header_subnote: All one hour long photography sessions include 10 edited images of your choosing and include free travel within 30 minutes.

addons.title: Printed Images
addons.body: All photos will be delivered digitally, or via flash drive for a $40 service fee. Meredith Lewis Photography does not offer printed images at this time.

addons.title: Additional Digital Images
addons.body: All one hour sessions will contain at least 30 edited images and they can be purchased at the rate of; One additional image: $25. Entire gallery: $100.

addons.title: Events
addons.body: All edited images are included in the event package at the rate of 40 edited digital images per hour.

header_intro: I always accept unique sessions. Contact me to inquire about a personalized session to fit your specific needs!
addons_bg_alt: An alpine tarn reflecting the sky among the rocks of the White Mountains.

services.name: Senior Portraits
services.alt: A high school senior in a white dress sitting in a sunlit field of wildflowers.
services.description: A senior portrait session includes 1 hour of coverage at 1-2 locations and 10 edited images. I'd love to get to know your senior, and to make their photos uniquely them!

services.name: Couples
services.alt: A couple embracing in front of a weathered grey barn.
services.description: A couples session includes 1 hour of coverage at 1-2 locations between 2 people and 10 edited images. I would love to capture your love story!

services.name: Engagement
services.alt: A close up of an engaged couple's hands showing the engagement ring.
services.description: An engagement session includes 1 hour of coverage at 1-2 locations  between two people and 10  edited images. There is nothing more I'd rather do than capture this special time in your life as you begin the rest of your lives together! Congratulations on our engagement!

services.name: Family
services.alt: A family of four with two young children together outdoors in the mountains.
services.description: A family session includes 1 hour of shooting time for up to 4 people at 1 location and 10 edited images. Each additional person added to the photoshoot is an additional $25. I can't wait to meet your special family!

services.name: Maternity
services.alt: An expecting couple holding an ultrasound photo in a field.
services.description: A maternity session includes 1 hour of coverage at 1 location and 10 edited images. This session includes up to 4 people, and additional people can be added at $25 per person. Congratulations mama!

services.name: Pet Photography
services.alt: A woman kissing her small dog outdoors.
services.description: Pet photography includes 1 hour of coverage at 1 location and 10 edited images. This shoot includes 2 people and your pup (up to 2). Additional people may be added at $25 per person. No one is more pet obsessed than me!

services.name: Events & Parties
services.alt: An elegant event table setup with floral arrangements and greenery.
services.description: Events include 2 hours of coverage at 1 location and all edited images. Whether it's a birthday party, bridal shower, sporting event, or even an anniversary, I'd love to photograph it! Additional event coverage may also be added to your day at $50 per hour.

services.name: Seasonal Mini Sessions
services.price: Minis & Pay What You Can Minis
services.alt: A mother and young son sitting together in a field of purple lupine flowers.
services.description: Fifteen minute mini sessions are offered seasonally throughout the year. Click below to see what seasonal sessions are currently being offered!
